targetReport.description: SPLIT 2026-10-18 (Thomas: 'split gb-voa-rating-lists into the Council Tax Valuation List and the Local Non-Domestic Rating List'): until then one node bundled both VOA lists under the title 'Local Non-Domestic Rating List / Council Tax Valuation List', against the one-node-per-document ruling (2026-10-05), and its own release_schedule note flagged it. This id keeps the business-rates list; the Council Tax list is now `gb-voa-council-tax-valuation-list`. The Valuation Office Agency's rating lists of non-domestic properties and their rateable values, the base on which business rates are charged. Compiled at each revaluation and in force from 1 April of the revaluation year: 2023, then 2026, every three years under the Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023. Legal basis, VERIFIED DIRECTLY in the August 2026 round (legislation.gov.uk): Local Government Finance Act 1988 ss.41, 61 and Sch.6. The url is the VOA's own rating list downloads page.

release_schedule.rule: Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023: from Royal Assent, business rates (non-domestic rating list) revaluations occur every 3 years rather than every 5, beginning with the list compiled 1 April 2026. New rating lists are compiled and come into force on 1 April in the revaluation year.

results.window:
The Business Rates Retention Scheme which commenced on 1 April 2013
          requires the Cabinet to formally approve the NNDR1 by the 31 January
          immediately preceding the financial year to which it relates. The NNDR1
          contains details of the rateable values shown for the authority's local rating list
          at 31 December and enables the Council to calculate the expected income in
          respect of business rates for the year, a proportion of which the Council has
          retained from 2013/14 onwards. 3.2.
